//: Codex PreToolUse hook gate: mechanical never-post enforcement for the
drafting arm (codex-side counterpart of tools/claude/rules/outbound-comment-gate.md).
INSTALL (once, interactive): merge the PreToolUse entries below into the
codex hooks config (see `/hooks` inside codex, or hooks.json per
https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks), then trust the definition when
codex prompts. Codex trust is hash-pinned: any edit to a hook requires
re-trust, which is exactly the tamper-evidence we want. Never run with
--dangerously-bypass-hook-trust.
STEP 1 — PROBE (run first, once): enable only the `probe-log` entry and do
one real `ticket-drafts-run`. Then inspect ~/.agents/outbox/hook-probe.log:
if Linear/Calendar connector tool names appear, connector calls ARE
hook-visible -> enable the deny entry and record hook_gate_active=true
(export TICKET_DRAFTS_HOOK_GATE=true in the wrapper environment).
If they do NOT appear, connectors bypass hooks -> record the finding in
the bundle README + triage doc and promote the frozen-snapshot increment;
set TICKET_DRAFTS_HOOK_GATE=false so run records carry honest provenance.
The matcher regex is written against Linear MUTATION tool-name shapes
(create/update/delete/save comment|issue|attachment). Verify actual tool
names from the probe log and tighten the regex to what is real before
trusting the deny hook. Field names below follow the documented
hooks.json shape; confirm against `/hooks` on the installed codex version
(0.143.0 at authoring time) during install.

PreToolUse.comment: probe-log: records every tool name codex attempts; never blocks
never-post-linear: deny any Linear mutation tool call

hooks.command: echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"never-post invariant: the drafting arm outputs text only; posting happens exclusively through ticket-drafts-review after human approval"}'
